pages.summary: EU AI Act Art-50 Watermarking Pack. Deadline 2026-08-02. 2 watermarking methods (machine-readable C2PA-style manifest + user-visible label). 5 robustness test classes (compression/crop/re-encoding/adversarial removal/paraphrasing) with ≥95% survival target. 5 cross-walks (C2PA v2.2 / NIST AI 100-4 / ISO 23894 / SynthID / Azure Content Authenticity). 7 implementation surfaces (text/image/audio/video/code/structured/API). Public verification <100ms.

aligned_to: EU AI Act Art-50 transparency obligations (in force 2026-08-02)
